Row 'Electrochemistry (30 pairs)' counts: Optimization wins both=13 teal; Optimization retest / Discovery prediction=13 ochre; Discovery retest / Optimization prediction=1 mauve; Discovery wins both=3 blue. Row 'Reaction processing (30 pairs)' same categories counts=4,5,4,17. Put each number on segment or callout, axis 0 10 20 30 matched pairs. Subtitle 'Matched world, information and budget'. Dumbbell plot with blue Opaque and ochre Aligned dots joined, x-axis macro MAE 0 to0.18, lower better. Five exact rows: Sol 0.01833 to0.15862; GPT-5.5 0.16325 to0.16146; Luna0.15240 to0.13319; Terra0.14611 to0.11466; Astra0.04040 to0.03853. No uncertainty whiskers.
